_written: 2026-11-06, decisions by the user (grant Aim 1B proxy benign classes), before element coordinates were given and before any variant was retrieved or counted
purpose: one added column on the user's gene table (GATA2, SHH, APC, MLH1, MSH2, GALT, VHL, HBB, LDLR, TERT, PAH, ANKRD26, HBG1, SLC39A4, NIPBL, RBM8A): per element, a stacked bar of proxy benign SNVs coloured by how many proxy benign classes support each SNV
elements: elements.tsv (hg38, 1-based inclusive), from the user 2026-11-06: GATA2 = +9.5 intronic enhancer, SHH = ZRS enhancer (LMBR1 intron), the rest as given. Target gene for AlphaGenome RNA = the row gene
universe: every possible SNV in the element, excluding SNVs with a ClinVar P/LP or B/LB record of >= 1 star (the benchmark, shown in the table's own P/LP and B/LB columns). Indels not counted

classes.gnomad: present in gnomAD v4.1, genomes or exomes, FILTER PASS, AC >= 1; no allele-frequency cutoff
classes.gtex: tested in GTEx V10 (in the V10 variant table with maf01 = true) AND not a significant single-tissue eQTL for any gene in any tissue. Variants not tested do NOT count
classes.alphagenome: no large AlphaGenome change: |mean raw score| over the element's track set not in the element's top 20% of possible SNVs, for RNA_SEQ (target gene, gene-mask LFC) and for DNASE (501-bp centre mask); both must be below the cutoff. Track set = the gene's Fiber-seq cell lines available in AlphaGenome: WTC11 EFO:0009747 (RNA, DNase), Jurkat E6-1 CLO:0007045 (RNA, DNase), K562 EFO:0002067 (RNA, DNase), HAP-1 EFO:0007598 (DNase only). HEK293T, HEL 92.1.7 and HUDEP-2 are not in AlphaGenome (HEK293 has CAGE only); erythroid genes with only HEL/HUDEP-2 use K562
classes.not_used: PromoterAI (user: AlphaGenome only); primate homozygotes (not run)

evidence_level: number of classes supporting the SNV, 0-3; the bar stacks levels 1, 2 and 3
benchmark: ClinVar germline P/LP and B/LB, review status >= 1 star (criteria provided), queried by window as the census

alphagenome_detail._written: 2026-11-06, with the coordinates, before any score
alphagenome_detail.track_sets: per element in elements.tsv (ag_rna, ag_dnase), from the table's Fiber-seq cell lines available in AlphaGenome; ANKRD26 uses its four non-erythroid lines (K562 substitution only when HEL/HUDEP-2 are the only lines, i.e. HBB)
alphagenome_detail.interval: 1 Mb (1,048,576 bp) centred on the element, except SHH: centred at 156,318,288 so the interval (155,794,000-156,842,576) contains both the SHH gene and the ZRS (~980 kb apart); RNA = SHH gene-mask LFC
alphagenome_detail.run: tools/promoter_variant_census/ag_score.py, one Slurm array task per element (cpu-g2, at most 8 at once to limit concurrent API connections)

bar_scale: percent of the element's possible SNVs (counts also written); user did not choose, the recommended option was used

v2_alphagenome_350bp._written: 2026-11-06, user: gnomAD and GTEx not helpful; show AlphaGenome-only proxy benigns in a 350 bp window, only if no AlphaGenome rerun is needed; before any 350 bp count was made
v2_alphagenome_350bp.proxy_benign: no large AlphaGenome change (RNA and DNase both outside the top 20%), with the cutoffs computed over the full 1 kb element (as v1) and applied to the SNVs inside the 350 bp window. gnomAD and GTEx not used
v2_alphagenome_350bp.window: 350 bp centred on the TSS: 175 bp upstream + TSS + 174 bp downstream in transcript orientation. TSS = 5' end of the Ensembl canonical (MANE Select) transcript of the gene, Ensembl REST, GRCh38. Enhancers (GATA2 +9.5, SHH ZRS) have no TSS: 350 bp centred on the 1 kb element (start + 325 .. start + 674; SHH 1,143 bp element: centre +/- 175 likewise). The 350 bp window must lie inside the 1 kb element (AlphaGenome scores exist only there); a gene where it does not is reported and clipped to the element, not re-scored
v2_alphagenome_350bp.universe: all 1,050 possible SNVs in the 350 bp window; SNVs with a >= 1-star ClinVar P/LP or B/LB record excluded (benchmark), as v1
v2_alphagenome_350bp.display: one column: count of proxy benign SNVs per gene (same denominator for every gene), single colour

window_revised._written: 2026-11-06, after the TSS lookup showed that TSS-centred windows run 50-175 bp past most 1 kb elements (no AlphaGenome scores there) and that APC and NIPBL have no MANE Select TSS inside; user chose, before any 350 bp count was made
window_revised.rule: 350 bp TSS-centred window (175 up, 174 down; TSS = MANE Select 5' end from the UCSC mane track), slid inward until it lies inside the 1 kb element, so it is the TSS-side 350 bp and still contains the TSS. APC: promoter 1B TSS (NM_001127511.3, chr5:112707498, +). NIPBL: the 350 bp at the element's 3' edge (the NIPBL TSS lies just outside; the only TSS inside is NIPBL-DT). GATA2 and SHH (enhancers): centred on the element. Every window = 1,050 possible SNVs
window_revised.tss_source: UCSC hg38 mane track (MANE Select), queried 2026-11-06; Ensembl REST was too slow

cutoff_350_comparison._written: 2026-11-06, user asked to compare against cutoffs computed inside the 350 bp window; before that count was made
cutoff_350_comparison.rule: same windows and SNVs as v2; large = |mean raw| in the top 20% of the 1,050 possible SNVs of the 350 bp window (all SNVs, benchmark included, as for the 1 kb cutoff), separately for RNA and DNase; proxy benign = both below. Compared with the 1 kb-cutoff version by count per gene and by overlap (SNVs called by both, by one only)
cutoff_350_comparison.decision: 2026-11-06, user: keep the 1 kb cutoff. Final table = v2_350bp/table_proxy_benign_350bp.png/.pdf; the 350 bp-cutoff version stays as a comparison only

v3_noncoding_clinvar._written: 2026-11-08, user: drop any ClinVar record that changes protein sequence on any transcript, annotate the rest by MANE Select, keep >= 1 star (after the Ellingford et al. 2022 comparison); before any recount
v3_noncoding_clinvar.protein_changing: a record is dropped if its ClinVar molecular_consequence_list (esummary; consequences on all transcripts ClinVar annotates) contains any of: missense, nonsense / stop gained, stop lost, frameshift, inframe insertion / deletion / indel, initiator codon (start lost). Synonymous, splice site and UTR / intron / non-coding transcript consequences do not change protein sequence and are kept (synonymous kept is a literal reading of the request; flagged in the outputs)
v3_noncoding_clinvar.mane_annotation: each kept record is labelled by its position on the element gene's MANE Select transcript (UCSC hg38 mane track): upstream (<= 2 kb of the TSS), 5'UTR, intron, 3'UTR, CDS (synonymous only), or other (> 2 kb from the MANE gene, e.g. APC promoter 1B, SHH ZRS); indels by their first changed base. Other MANE genes overlapping the record are listed
v3_noncoding_clinvar.benchmark: >= 1-star ClinVar P/LP and B/LB records that are not protein-changing; SNVs among them are excluded from the proxy benign counts as before. Everything else (windows, AlphaGenome rule, 1 kb cutoff) unchanged
